Creative Brief
What objective are we aiming to achieve?
To reinforce Alex as trusted cough expert among HCPs by delivering clear, credible and differentiated creative communication.
To grow market share in key geographies by strengthening preference for Alex

What problem are we trying to solve?
Despite Alex being the trusted brand in Dry Cough, loss of rank & market share slipping in some key states due to aggressive visibility of rival brands (Zedex, Grilinctus-DX, Tusq-DX)
Cough being low involvement category and due to cluttered market doctors perceive all the cough brands as similar.

Who’s the target audience (types of HCPs)?
General Practioners, Consultant Physicians & Pediatricinas

What is their Current belief / behavior?
Many doctors believe that most of brands in the category deliver similar efficacy. Hence prescribing often depends on habit, relationship with the company rather than strong brand differentiation.
Alex is seen as reliable & established brand, may be not the first recalled brand.

What is their Desired belief / behavior?
To strengthen perception as Alex is not just the another cough syrup – it is The Cough Expert.

What are the blocks/ barriers for changing this behavior?
Doctors see all cough syrups as similar in efficacy.
Aggressive competition and their engagement, increased visibility.

What is our single-line single-minded brand proposition?
Alex – The Trusted Dry Cough Expert who delivers proven relief with superior taste across different patient profiles.
